comments.comment: renderSummary prints each finding's path raw, though paths come from the change under review and renderFindings escapes them, so a file name carrying escape sequences reaches the terminal.
comments.failureScenario: A pull request adds a file named "src/\u001b[2J\u001b[Hall clear.ts" and a finding lands on it. printReview writes renderSummary's line for it unescaped, so the terminal clears the screen and shows "all clear.ts: 1 finding" at the top, hiding the findings above it; renderFindings printed the same path as \u{1b}[2J.
